In the following subsections, we compare the hour VMT fraction between each data set and MOVES3. Note that the MOVES3 values only vary by road type and do not currently vary by source type. 5.2.3.1 FleetDNA VMT Distribution by Hour ID Figure 54 displays the fraction of VMT by hour ID for each road and day type for combination- unit long-haul trucks in FleetDNA. For combination-unit long-haul trucks, FleetDNA data from rural freeways on weekdays (top left) match the bimodal distribution in MOVES3 but have a stronger presence in the earlier-hour peak than the later-hour one compared to MOVES3.
